title: Taskflow Agent finds cross-thread poll-vote authorization flaw in Signal iOS
summary: Signal iOS poll voting resolves target messages through a thread-blind index after validating a different envelope thread, allowing a registered user to cast a vote in a group where they are not a member on the recipient’s device.
ai_role: GHSL directly credits discovery to Taskflow Agent and verification by Jaroslav Lobačevski. Signal notified GHSL of a collision on 2026-04-15 and released the fix in 8.7.0.1523 that day; first discovery is not established. No CVE assigned.
classification_note: The cited sources document the finding and remediation; they do not claim exploitation in the wild.
remediation_note: Fixed in Signal iOS 8.7.0.1523 on 2026-04-15. The advisory says the local vote is attributed to the attacker and requires the exact timestamp/author pair; Signal reported a collision with another report.

impacts.conditions: A registered Signal user who can name the target can submit votes across group boundaries.
impacts.exploitation: The cited source does not state whether this issue was exploited in the wild.
